source: sources/documents/2025-08-14-cards-faq.md What is the minimum payment?
text: The minimum is the smallest payment due to keep the card in good standing, calculated as a regulated percentage dependent on card limit; use the exact statement or app amount.

source: sources/documents/2025-08-14-cards-faq.md What happens if I only pay the minimum?
text: Minimum payment keeps the card in good standing but interest applies to unpaid balance; only full statement payment avoids interest.

source: sources/documents/2025-08-14-cards-faq.md And if I pay less than the minimum, or nothing?
text: Underpayment attracts late-payment interest and may affect credit records; several consecutive unpaid minimums may close new spending; customers struggling to pay should contact the bank early.
